keypoints.name: Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR)
keypoints.description: LQR is a control design technique that involves finding an optimal full state feedback controller by minimizing a cost function that penalizes both state deviations and control effort. The gain matrix K is computed in a way that balances these costs based on weighting matrices Q and R.

keypoints.name: Q and R Weighting Matrices
keypoints.description: Q and R are weighting matrices used to tune the LQR controller by specifying how much to penalize deviations in the states (Q) versus the control effort (R). Adjusting these matrices allows for balancing performance and control effort, leading to aggressive or conservative control strategies.
